# developer.paypal.com documentation — Api — Payments.Payouts Batch

> 3 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Payments.Payouts Batch. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Payments.Payouts Batch

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1/payouts-get/): Shows the latest status of a batch payout. Includes the transaction status and other data for individual payout items.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1/payouts-item-get/): Shows details for a payout item, by ID. A
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1/payouts-item-cancel/): Cancels an unclaimed payout item, by ID. If no one claims the unclaimed item within 30 days, the API automatically returns the funds to the sender.
